{"diagnosis": "Loopback send 0xa5 never sets recv_buf_valid, causing TRAP uart timeout and tohost FAIL 0xdead vs expected received byte. Excerpt shows duplicate `1:` labels at lines 78 and 83 with no `0:` idle branch, so start-bit detect `if (!ser_rx) recv_state <= 1` is unreachable and half-bit wait is shadowed. Root cause is mistyped idle case label blocking RX FSM out of reset state 0.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picosoc/simpleuart.v b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
--- a/picosoc/simpleuart.v
+++ b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
@@ -77,3 +77,3 @@
 			case (recv_state)
-				1: begin
+				0: begin
 					if (!ser_rx)", "expected": "tohost PASS loopback 0xa5 received, no uart timeout TRAP"}

diagnosis: Loopback send 0xa5 never sets recv_buf_valid, causing TRAP uart timeout and tohost FAIL 0xdead vs expected received byte. Excerpt shows duplicate `1:` labels at lines 78 and 83 with no `0:` idle branch, so start-bit detect `if (!ser_rx) recv_state <= 1` is unreachable and half-bit wait is shadowed. Root cause is mistyped idle case label blocking RX FSM out of reset state 0.
expected: tohost PASS loopback 0xa5 received, no uart timeout TRAP
